description: Market price of a used car for sale in Spain, from the adverts of thousands of dealers, read again every day: the usual asking price (median), the range where half the cars are advertised (p25 to p75) and how many comparable cars it is based on. With an asking price it also says whether that price is expensive, fair or cheap. Works for any car, listed with us or not. Make and model are written as people write them ("SEAT", "León", "Mercedes-Benz", "Clase C"); case and accents do not matter. Use list_models when unsure of the spelling.
name: check_price
title: Check a used car price in Spain
